title: Industrial Disputes Act, 1947 — Section 22 (Prohibition of strikes and lock-outs)

content.overview: Section 22 prohibits strikes and lock-outs in public utility services without the prescribed notice and during the protected period.
content.glance: Section 22 prohibits strikes and lock-outs in public utility services without the prescribed notice and during the protected period.
content.study: In a public utility service, no person employed shall go on strike, and no employer shall lock out, without giving notice in the prescribed manner and waiting out the notice period. A strike or lock-out is also barred during conciliation and for a short period after its conclusion.

sections.heading: Operative rule
sections.body: Section 22 prohibits strikes and lock-outs in public utility services without the prescribed notice and during the protected period.
